verdict.rationale: Working Copy is an iOS app, and its only documented unattended automation is on-device: Shortcuts app actions that pass files and data between steps, plus Auto-Sync and Background Sync that commit, pull and push when changes are detected. This is device-local automation, not true headless or CI execution. Missing for 10: a CLI or headless runtime, CI/server execution, an API for programmatic control (OpenAPI probes returned 404), and independent corroboration.
